mapper.insert: insert into user (openid,name, phone, sex, id_number, avatar, create_time) values (#{openid}, #{name}, #{phone}, #{sex}, #{idNumber}, #{avatar}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(date ORDER BY date SEPARATOR ',') AS dateList, GROUP_CONCAT(totalUser ORDER BY date SEPARATOR ',') AS totalUserList, GROUP_CONCAT(newUser ORDER BY date SEPARATOR ',') AS newUserList FROM ( SELECT DATE(create_time) AS date, COUNT(id) AS totalUser, SUM(IF(create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY), 1, 0)) AS newUser FROM user WHERE create_time >= #{beginTime} AND create_time <= #{endTime} GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ) AS daily_stats;
